purpose: Evaluate one preregistered, outcome-blind LoadLeast/OCS state-proxy family on a fresh E31-E35 development cohort after V23 placed the Jiagu current-demand proxy second for both throughput and QPR. All nine baselines and all three NSESche candidates are completed before any performance result is read.

fresh_development_cohort.reason: E31-E35 have not been expanded, captured, referenced, or executed. E21-E30 are closed to further tuning; E04-E10 remain unused; E11-E20 remain sealed confirmation seeds.

source.high_profile_note: The global frozen high profile remains 7k; V24 itself runs low only.

diagnostic_basis.reason_for_family: The remaining V23 gaps are to two frozen placement baselines. LoadLeast lexicographically minimizes current plus projected task count and node ID. OCS uses a fixed container-state, memory-headroom, task-load, and recent-affinity score with weights 0.55/0.20/0.15/0.10. V24 copies these rules without fitting new weights and retains V23b's current-window function-demand player order.

candidates.definition: Order functions by current-window demand, then minimize the frozen LoadLeast key: current pending plus running tasks plus same-window projected assignments, followed by node ID.
Order functions by current-window demand, then maximize the frozen OCS score 0.55 container state + 0.20 memory headroom + 0.15 task-load headroom + 0.10 recent function affinity.
Use the frozen OCS score when current-window demand for the function is exactly one; use the frozen LoadLeast key when demand is greater than one. The threshold is fixed before tape capture.

development_matrix.result_blind_execution_order: Commit this plan before expanding E31-E40. Capture E31-E35 only after the plan commit. Build references serially. Complete and QC all baseline and candidate runs serially before calculating any throughput, latency, cost, QPR, ranking, or candidate comparison.

eligibility_per_candidate: all five reference builds and candidate runs pass QC and result-blind pairing
all 45 baseline runs pass QC and result-blind pairing
mean fixed-window throughput is strictly greater than every one of the nine baseline means on E31-E35
mean QPR is strictly greater than every one of the nine baseline means on E31-E35
frozen V8 middle/high E01-E03 retain first-place throughput and QPR
selection_rule: Run all three candidates completely. Among candidates passing every gate, freeze the first in fixed priority v24c, v24b, v24a (the preregistered router, then OCS, then LoadLeast). Ties with a baseline do not pass. If none pass, select none, do not subdivide or retune this family on E31-E35, and keep confirmation sealed.

confirmation.closure_requirement: For every load, optimized NSESche must rank first in mean fixed-window throughput and QPR against frozen E11-E20 baselines; otherwise report not closed without seed deletion or confirmation-set tuning.
